reference.policy: The commit hash, not a release nickname, is authoritative.

status_semantics.unreviewed: Extracted from the frozen Linux UAPI but not audited in EdgeOS.
status_semantics.partial: Some operations exist, but Linux semantic parity is incomplete.
status_semantics.configured-off: Behavior must match Linux with the same Kconfig disabled.
status_semantics.unsupported-subsystem: EdgeOS has no backend and must not expose a fake device.
status_semantics.verified: Linux oracle and EdgeOS runtime evidence both pass.
